candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue and other operating income increased by 40 percent to DKK 126,523 thousand compared to DKK 90,070 thousand in 2024.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization grew by 26 percent to DKK 31,117 thousand, up from DKK 24,671 thousand in the prior year, yielding an EBITDA-margin of 25 percent.
Profit before tax reached DKK 19,013 thousand, representing a 109 percent increase compared to DKK 9,068 thousand in 2024, resulting in an EBT-margin of 15 percent.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, driven by Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13); Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18)

candidate_sentences.text: This expansion was primarily driven by the successful scaling of the Transport Game Series, specifically the Big Three titles consisting of Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager, which collectively generated 67 percent of total revenue amounting to DKK 85 million.
Truck Manager scaled rapidly to DKK 25,181 thousand, while Farm Manager, launched in July 2025 following five million pre-registrations, contributed DKK 22,002 thousand in its first six months.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).

verified_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are all PRESENT with clear evidence in the candidate summary. K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of the framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong but the absence of K6—a HIGH importance item—prevents the summary from achieving a 'Yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements build logically upon each other, showing clear cause-effect relationships (e.g., marketing investment driving user acquisition, new game launches contributing to revenue growth). The numerical relationships are presented as segment contributions without implying exhaustive additive consolidation. The structure progresses naturally from revenue performance to profitability metrics, balance sheet items, and forward guidance. There are no contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetitions that would materially reduce clarity.
